name: Sleep Cycle
one_liner: Sleep Cycle tracks your sleep with your phone's microphone or motion sensor, records snoring, and wakes you with an alarm timed to lighter sleep.
best_for: Seeing rough patterns in your sleep without buying a wearable
A wake-up alarm timed within a window you choose
Recording snoring or sleep-talking to show a doctor
not_for: Chronic insomnia, which is better treated with CBT-I
Diagnosing sleep apnea or other sleep disorders; see a doctor
People who want accurate sleep-stage measurement; phone apps are not reliable for that
short_description: Phone-based sleep tracker with a smart alarm, snore recording and sleep sounds. Free version; most features need Premium.
long_description: Sleep Cycle, from the Swedish company Sleep Cycle AB, is a sleep tracking and alarm app for iPhone and Android. You leave your phone by the bed; it uses the microphone (or motion sensor) to estimate sleep, records snoring and sleep-talking, and wakes you during a window you set when it detects lighter sleep. It also has sleep sounds and statistics. A free version includes the basic alarm and tracking; most history, sounds and coaching features need Premium. It is a tracker, not a treatment, and an independent 2020 study that compared it with laboratory sleep testing ('(Not so) Smart sleep tracking through the phone') questioned how reliably phone apps measure sleep.
patient_summary: You set an alarm window, put your phone by your bed, and Sleep Cycle listens through the night, then wakes you when it thinks you are sleeping lightly and shows your sleep and snoring in the morning. The basic app is free; Premium unlocks most extras. It cannot diagnose or treat a sleep problem.

pricing.notes: Free version includes the smart alarm and basic tracking; Premium adds full history, snore and sleep-talk recordings, sounds and more. The US annual price was reported at $39.99 in 2026 (up from $29.99); prices vary by country and store, and discounts are common. Check the in-app price.

privacy.notes: App policy (read 2026-10-27) describes no ad sharing of app or health data, but the site's cookie notice on the policy page says it shares site-use data with advertising partners to serve personalized ads; you can delete data in the app or delete your account.

seo.title: Sleep Cycle: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Sleep Cycle tracks your sleep with your phone's microphone or motion sensor and wakes you in a light sleep phase with its smart alarm.

faqs.q: How much does Sleep Cycle cost?
faqs.a: Free; Premium up to about $57.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Sleep Cycle before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Sleep Cycle replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Sleep Cycle is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Sleep Cycle?
faqs.a: Sleep Cycle is available on iPhone and Android.
Phone-based sleep tracking; Smart alarm; Snore and sleep-talk detection; Sleep sounds and AI coach.
